title: Can I allow several judgement-call blocks together
question: Can I allow several judgement-call blocks together?
answer: Use all anyway applies to the currently allow-able stickers in that batch. Its number counts eligible overrides, and Take all back reverses those allowances. If this does not match what you see, send a screenshot in Help.
looks_like: Use all anyway has a count next to the button; Take all back is the reverse control.
